name: Pre-AP Chemistry
tagline: One kit per chapter. Pick a chapter to study; progress in each one is saved in this browser.

units.label: Chapter 3
units.title: Matter
units.blurb: States of matter, physical and chemical changes, elements, compounds and mixtures, and separating mixtures (sections 3.1 to 3.5).

units.label: Chapter 4
units.title: Elements, Atoms, and Ions
units.blurb: The periodic table, the history of the atom, protons, neutrons and electrons, isotopes and average atomic mass, ions and ionic formulas, and molar mass and the mole (sections 4.3 to 4.11).
